metadata.title: High-Contrast Monochrome Portrait with Diagonal Script

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white close-up portrait featuring a subject with a musical instrument, overlaid with a bold, vibrant red diagonal script and a secondary sans-serif display font.
excludeWhen: minimalist layout without text is requested
modern digital clean-line aesthetics are preferred

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast black and white headshot of a man wearing a hat, holding a trumpet diagonally across his chest. The image is defined by deep blacks and bright whites, with a prominent, thick red script title running diagonally from bottom-left to mid-right, and a secondary bold sans-serif name in the top right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal orientation of the trumpet mirrors the angle of the primary script text.
The vibrant red of the script provides a singular, intense color contrast against the monochrome background.
The subject's direct gaze creates an intimate connection, framed by the hat brim and the instrument.
coreInvariants: Diagonal composition of both subject elements and text
Single-color accent (red) for the primary title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up headshot centered horizontally, with the instrument extending from the bottom left to the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright red script title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, follows the diagonal line of the trumpet down to the red script, then moves up to the top-right name.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: High-key white background surrounding the subject's head and hat.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and white (monochrome) for the photographic base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the background and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant, saturated red for the primary title.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast in the photo; maximum saturation in the red accent.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Fluid, connected script with varying stroke thickness.
letterConstructionRules: Connected lowercase letters with a large, stylized initial capital
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial 'F' features a long, sweeping horizontal bar that underlines the subsequent letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Vibrant, organic script paired with a rigid, geometric sans-serif for functional contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, hand-drawn feel of the primary title.
Matches the bold, condensed feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white close-up portrait of a man in a hat holding a trumpet diagonally. The background should be blown-out white.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold red script title diagonally across the bottom half, overlapping the trumpet. Add a bold, black, condensed sans-serif name in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the photo strictly black and white with high contrast?
Is the primary script text a vibrant red?
Is the text placed on a diagonal axis?
Is the secondary text in a bold, condensed sans-serif?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact brand logos on the instrument
Specific wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red script is the only color element.
Check that the diagonal of the text aligns with the diagonal of the instrument.
Verify the high-key white background is clean.
Confirm the secondary text is legible in the top right.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast monochrome portrait with a single-color diagonal script overlay to create a dynamic, vintage-inspired editorial look.
